notes: Partition verified: all 37 source ids and all 43 target ids occur exactly once; the unrepresented units are s011 (paragogic/cohortative he, tagged Sh, rule 32), s021 (the suffix on אֲדֹנָי, which the ASV renders bare as *Lord*) and s026 (the bare object marker, rule 16).
Rule 45's middle case is correctly applied: the apodosis opens with its own waw at s009, so that waw carries the frame's *that* and s002 keeps only *it came to pass*.

s003 takes the temporal subordinator *while* and s004 keeps *were smiting* with the suffix s005 supplying the subject *they*, which is rule 52's division read together with rule 18's infinitive-construct clause.
s023 takes the fronted question auxiliary *wilt* under rule 17, in a clause whose predicate is a participle; s025's explicit pronoun keeps only *thou* and s024 keeps *destroy*.

s033 is the one marker in the verse that takes English: the gerund reaches its object through *of*, no other morpheme licenses that word, and rule 16's subtraction leaves only the object relation diminished. The note names the competing reading that would mark the marker unrepresented and the *of* added (rule 8).
